# Igris 2.0.5

- Libraries.dev Beam accents frame the active chat composer and briefing conversation. Silver Metal effects highlight primary call actions and the microphone in the shared Windows/Android workspace.
- Decorative effects respect reduced motion and pause in the background. Plain controls remain usable when WebGL is unavailable.
- Android speech input now previews partial words, shows readiness and specific recognition errors, supports Stop listening, and bounds each attempt to 30 seconds. Opening the microphone permission prompt keeps the call alive; leaving the app stops voice input.
- Call follow-ups submit only final transcripts. Ending the call cancels recognition and suppresses late results. Supported desktop speech recognition uses the browser engine rather than an unavailable native command.

The owner confirmed real Android speech input and a response on the updated debug app. All 37 shared workspace regression tests passed; Android compilation and lint passed with zero errors. Existing account data, scheduling, pairing and encryption secrets are preserved. Android production signing remains deferred; the debug app is a separate installation. Windows publication/build validation is recorded in V2_QA_REPORT.md after verification.
